description: This file contains functions and types for processing, sanitizing, and repairing agent message transcripts related to tool calls, including redaction, validation, and reordering of tool result messages.

methods.name: isRawToolCallBlock
methods.description: Type guard to check if a given object is a RawToolCallBlock based on its 'type' property.

methods.name: hasToolCallInput
methods.description: Checks if a tool call block has non-null 'input' or 'arguments' fields.

methods.name: hasNonEmptyStringField
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string.

methods.name: hasToolCallId
methods.description: Determines if a tool call block has a non-empty 'id' string.

methods.name: normalizeAllowedToolNames
methods.description: Normalizes an iterable of tool names into a set of lowercase trimmed strings for validation.

methods.name: hasToolCallName
methods.description: Checks if a tool call block's 'name' is valid and optionally within allowed names.

methods.name: redactSessionsSpawnAttachmentsArgs
methods.description: Redacts 'content' fields within attachments in a given object, replacing content with a placeholder.

methods.name: sanitizeToolCallBlock
methods.description: Sanitizes a tool call block, especially redacting large/sensitive content for 'sessions_spawn' tool calls.

methods.name: makeMissingToolResult
methods.description: Creates a synthetic 'toolResult' message indicating a missing tool result for session repair.

methods.name: trimNonEmptyString
methods.description: Trims a string and returns undefined if the result is empty.

methods.name: normalizeToolResultName
methods.description: Normalizes the 'toolName' in a tool result message, defaulting to 'unknown' if necessary.

methods.name: stripToolResultDetails
methods.description: Removes 'details' property from 'toolResult' messages in a list.

methods.name: repairToolCallInputs
methods.description: Sanitizes and repairs agent messages, especially tool call blocks, removing invalid entries and fixing names.

methods.name: shouldDropErroredAssistantResults
methods.description: Determines if errored assistant results should be dropped based on options.

methods.name: repairToolUseResultPairing
methods.description: Rearranges, deduplicates, and inserts missing tool results in message transcripts for consistency.
